refined_requirements.name: Formation Change Analysis Over Time
refined_requirements.description: Analyze how the formation type changes across different moments in the match, such as specific time intervals or events.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Usage Frequency Statistics
refined_requirements.description: Calculate the frequency of each formation type being used during the match to identify dominant formations.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Transition Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Investigate the transitions between different formation types and identify patterns or triggers for these changes.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Correlation with Key Match Events
refined_requirements.description: Analyze the relationship between formation changes and key match events such as goals, substitutions, or tactical decisions.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Distribution Across Match Phases
refined_requirements.description: Examine how formations are distributed across different phases of the match, such as first half, second half, or specific game situations.

d.name: Brazil_Formation.data
d.description: Input data table containing formation data

D.name: Formation_Timestamp_Binning
D.description: Group formation data by time intervals to analyze formation changes over time
D.task: Aggregate the 'formation_type' column by time intervals (e.g., every 10 seconds) using the 'frame_id' as a proxy for time. Create a new column 'time_interval' to represent each interval.

D.name: Formation_Frequency_Calculation
D.description: Calculate the frequency of each formation type used during the match
D.task: Count the occurrences of each 'formation_type' in the dataset and calculate their relative frequencies. Group by 'formation_type' and sum the counts.

D.name: Formation_Transition_Matrix
D.description: Identify transitions between different formation types
D.task: Create a transition matrix that tracks how often one formation type follows another. Use the 'frame_id' to determine the order of formations and count the number of transitions between each pair of formation types.

D.name: Event_Formation_Linkage
D.description: Link formation changes with key match events
D.task: Identify key match events (e.g., goals, substitutions) and cross-reference them with the formation data. For each event, record the formation type before and after the event to identify patterns.

D.name: Phase_Formation_Distribution
D.description: Analyze formation distribution across match phases
D.task: Segment the match into phases (e.g., first half, second half, specific game situations). For each phase, calculate the frequency of each formation type and compare across phases.

V.name: Formation_Change_Over_Time
V.description: Shows how formation types change over different time intervals in the match

V.name: Formation_Frequency_Distribution
V.description: Displays the frequency of each formation type used during the match

V.name: Formation_Transition_Matrix
V.description: Visualizes the transitions between different formation types

V.name: Formation_Event_Relationship
V.description: Analyzes the relationship between formation changes and key match events

V.name: Formation_Phase_Distribution
V.description: Shows how formations are distributed across different match phases

I.name: Time_Intervals_Filter
I.description: Allows users to filter the formation change chart by specific time intervals

I.description: Allows users to filter the formation frequency chart by specific formation types
